text: Law is a discipline that takes legal phenomena and their laws as its research object, aiming to systematically explain legal principles, norms and practices, and cultivate professional talents with legal thinking, practical ability and a sense of social justice. As an interdisciplinary field of social sciences and humanities, law not only involves the interpretation of legal provisions (such as the Constitution and the Civil Code), but also covers the value logic behind the law (such as fairness and justice), social functions (such as rights protection and order maintenance), and historical evolution (such as the influence of Roman law on modern rule of law). The major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, serving areas such as legislation, judiciary, law enforcement, and legal services. It is a core supporting discipline in a modern society ruled by law.
